# 2.00 USD bought for 2.01 CAD, 1.005 CAD per USD, then sold 1.00 USD at a
# time for 1.40 CAD each. The first sale is valued at its cost rounded to the
# cent: 1.005, half up, 1.01, with a realized gain of 0.39.
#
# The second sale, the last of that cost basis, is in a file of its own:
#
# - ..._the_last_at_what_is_left.txt values it at what is left of the 2.01,
#   1.00, and its gain is 0.40, so the two come to the realized gain:
#   2.80 − 2.01 = 0.79;
# - ..._the_last_at_its_own_share.txt values it at its own share rounded,
#   1.01, as the first. The two values add up to 2.02 of the 2.01 the dollars
#   cost, and the gains to 0.78.
#
# That is the reported case the other way round: there each share rounded
# down and a realized loss went unrecorded; here each rounds up and a realized
# gain does.
#
# A third dollar is bought at 1.30 and still held, so a balance sheet at 1.40
# (fx_rates_usd_at_1_40.yaml) states an unrealized gain of 0.10.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_the_last_disposal_of_a_cost_basis_takes_what_is_left_of_its_cost.py and
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_sheet_states_the_realized_gain_the_book_did_not_record.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

	Assets:Chequing 100.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -100.00 CAD

2026-01-05 * "Buy 2.00 USD for 2.01 CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 2.00 USD
		guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000001"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "201/200"
		value: "2.01"
	Assets:Chequing -2.01 CAD

2026-02-01 * "Sell 1.00 USD for 1.40 CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Chequing 1.40 CAD
	Assets:USD Bank -1.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "101/100"
		value: "-1.01"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000001"
	Income:Foreign exchange gains/losses -0.39 CAD

2026-03-05 * "Buy 1.00 USD for 1.30 CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 1.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "1.30"
	Assets:Chequing -1.30 CAD
